sources.title: Nathan Halko, Per-Gunnar Martinsson, and Joel A. Tropp, Finding Structure with Randomness: Probabilistic Algorithms for Constructing Approximate Matrix Decompositions
sources.locator: Complete 74-page author-hosted preprint fetched. Read §§4.1 and 4.5 (range finder and power scheme); §9.1 and Proposition 8.6 (deterministic partition and power inequality); §§10.1–10.2 and the proof of Theorem 10.6; Appendix A.1–A.2 statements/proof routes. The real scaled-product proposition explicitly cites Gordon without proving it; the pseudoinverse results cite Wishart/Chen–Dongarra material. Those imported arguments were not treated as local proofs.
sources.reading_verification: The full PDF body was fetched and inspected; the complete cited sections and theorem proof were read. Appendix claims that cite external sources were recorded as source limitations, not accepted as proof.
